dict.Lângă felii se salvează și o pagină web: Next to the slices, a web page that puts them back together is saved too, with the links chosen below
dict.Legăturile se pot pune pe cel mult 64 de: Links can be set on at most 64 slices; the page is saved without links.
dict.Și o pagină web (.html) cu feliile puse: Also a web page (.html) with the slices put back together
dict.Trage pe previzualizare ca să desenezi o: Drag on the preview to draw a slice (with Shift also over another one); drag a slice to move it, or drag its bottom-right corner to make it smaller / larger; click a slice to delete it.
